text: The purpose of this report is to seek authority to amend Purchase Order No. 6041437 for Contract No. MCP13-19WP with Aplus General Contractors Corporation for the construction and rehabilitation of the process control building. In 2015, as part of the Toronto Water state of good repair backlog initiatives, the process control building construction contract was awarded to Aplus General Contractors Corporation at Highland Creek Treatment Plant. Given the age and nature of this facility, greater than normal unforeseen issues and new discoveries have surfaced.

The Public Works and Infrastructure Committee: 1. In accordance with Section 71-11.1.C of the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 71 (Financial Control By-Law), granted authority to amend Purchase Order No. 6041437 for Contract No. MCP13-19WP with Aplus General Contractors Corporation, by an additional amount of $1,300,000 net of all taxes ($1,322,880 net of HST recoveries), revising the current total value from $13,504,400 to $14,804,400 net of all taxes ($15,064,957 net of HST recoveries).
